firms.name: Era Trade

assetsEvidence.sourceQuote: Можно торговать форекс, акции, крипту, индексы, металлы и сырьё с ультра-низкими RAW-спредами и одними из самых низких комиссий на рынке.
assetsEvidence.notes: Stocks are listed for TradeLocker only; Bybit challenges are USDT futures only.

platformEvidence.notes: Homepage hero. The trading-platforms help page (https://help.eratrade.club/ru/trading-platforms/) describes Bybit, MetaTrader 5 and TradeLocker. Vantage is the copy-trading product, not a challenge terminal.

firms.payoutFrequencyNote: Trader chooses a 15- or 30-day payout period, counted from the first completed trade on the funded account; at least 3 profitable days (≥0.5%) per period; min 1% / max 10% of starting balance per period; processing up to 5 business days.
firms.payoutFrequencyQuote: Запрашивать выплату можно каждые 15 или 30 дней — на выбор трейдера . Отсчёт начинается с первой завершённой сделки на Funded-аккаунте
firms.payoutMethodsQuote: Запросить выплату можно в следующих криптовалютах: USDT — сети TRC20, ERC20 или BEP20 ; BTC ; ETH ; LTC .
firms.consistencyRule: Instant accounts only: best day ≤25% of payout-eligible profit (plus 10 trading / 7 profitable days). No consistency rule published for 1-step or 2-step. 1-step needs 6 trading days; 2-step has no minimum or time limit.
firms.countriesRestrictedNote: No named country list published (ToS last updated 10 July 2026); only 'comprehensively sanctioned or prohibited' jurisdictions are excluded and Era Trade may restrict any country at its discretion. Empty list = none named, not 'no restrictions'.
firms.russiaSourceQuote: you are not located, resident or established in a comprehensively sanctioned or prohibited jurisdiction;
firms.headquarters: Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
firms.corporateNote: Free-zone company, License Number 89779, Registration Number 83014 (as stated in the ToS).

firms.name: TeamTraders

assetsEvidence.sourceQuote: До 2 млн рублей на брокерский счёт на фьючерсах Мосбиржи.
assetsEvidence.notes: Moscow Exchange futures via Finam; the FAQ also says MOEX shares are available in connections ('Да, рынок акций доступен в подключениях'), with selection terms in the cabinet. Founded: homepage 'C 2018 года'.

platformEvidence.notes: New demo connections use Privod Bondar 2.0 (FAQ).

firms.profitSplitNote: 95% on the real account only. After the two-step internship traders first get a funded demo account with a 50% share, capped at 10% of the deposit (2026-10-01 evidence said 70%).
firms.payoutFrequencyNote: Official pages conflict: /faq says withdrawal requests weekly, up to 50% of currently available profit (funded demo and real account); the homepage says requests daily, no limit. Left null until resolved.
firms.payoutFrequencyQuote: При наличии положительной прибыли на счёте трейдер может еженедельно подавать заявку на вывод до 50% от текущей доступной прибыли.
firms.payoutMethodsNote: No payout method published for the MOEX programme; requests go through the web cabinet or info@teamtraders.ru.
firms.countriesRestrictedNote: No country list or residency clause published on /, /faq or /rules. Empty list = none named.
firms.russiaStatusNote: Inferred from the operator and product, not from an eligibility clause: Russian sole proprietor contracting under Russian law, RUB prices, MOEX futures via Finam. No published clause names or excludes Russian residents.
firms.russiaSourceQuote: «Исполнитель» – ИП Клычев Алишер Алиджанович ОГРНИП 323400000016841 ИНН 400000476601, который дистанционно оказывает Услуги
